integrity: Complete all-length proof based on forced-path contraction and BEST, supplemented by independently enumerated Euler tours for orders 2..7 and exact directed Matrix-Tree cofactors for orders 2..10.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabets, internal transition count at most two, rotation equivalence only; does not extend by assertion to higher change bounds, error correction, or reversible equivalence. Independent mathematical review is not yet performed.
title: Exact enumeration of binary universal cycles with at most two changes per window
